restoration_note: Teaching 36 describes the cosmic mirror-Wheel (prochos) standing before the Gate of the King of Honor — the cyclic mechanism by which the bound archons of all firmaments are held transparent to judicial Divine Truth. Restoration was strongly constrained by: (1) the recurring formula ⲡⲡⲣⲟⲭⲟⲥ ⲉⲧⲙⲙⲉⲩ 'that prochos'; (2) the ⲥⲧⲉⲣⲉⲱⲙⲁ word breaking across lines (gaps 2, 7, 8); (3) the parallel construction at lines 23–24 ⲥⲉⲭⲁⲗⲭ ⲥⲉⲁϩⲧ ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧϥ̄ which fixes gaps 9 and 10; (4) standard formulae like ⲍⲓⲧⲉⲍⲏ, ⲡⲣⲟ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ ⲡⲧⲁⲓⲟ, ⲛⲉⲧⲙⲙⲉⲩ. The middle stretch (gaps 22–33) suffered heavy damage with multiple consecutive lacunae of 6–10 chars and no anchoring formula; these are honestly left unrestored. Gap 37 was tentatively filled by the dominant subject of judgment in this chapter (the archons in him).
